Xiaomi USB-PD charge-pump battery-profile voltage opt-in

For compatible = "xiaomi,usbpd-pm":

- mi,respect-bms-voltage-limit
  Usage: optional
  Value type: <empty>
  Definition: Limit the battery-voltage control-loop target to the smaller
    of the configured FFC/non-FFC board limit and BMS VOLTAGE_MAX_DESIGN.
    The BMS property is in microvolts and is rounded down to millivolts.
    Values outside 3500000..5000000 uV or unavailable properties cause
    charge-pump operation to stop/retry via the switching-charger path.
    The check runs before pump entry and throughout tuning. If absent,
    preserve the original board/mode voltage policy. This property does
    not raise board limits or change current, JEITA or thermal settings.
